pages.text: Wireless terminals are portable versions of the regular wired $(l:items_blocks_machines/terminals)terminals$(/l). They have the exact same UIs as their wired counterparts, except instead of slots for $(l:items_blocks_machines/view_cell)View Cell$(/l)s, they have slots for $(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)upgrade cards$(/l)$(br2)In order to pair them with a network, insert the terminal in the top-right slot of a $(l:items_blocks_machines/wireless_access_point)ME Wireless Access Point$(/l) connected to that network. (The

slot with a picture of a wireless terminal on it and an arrow below it)$(br2)They must be within range of a $(l:items_blocks_machines/wireless_access_point)ME Wireless Access Point$(/l) to function.$(br2)Their energy can be recharged in a $(l:items_blocks_machines/charger)Charger$(/l).

Your basic terminal, now portable! View and access the contents of your $(l:ae2_mechanics/import_export_storage)network's storage$(/l) and request things from your $(l:ae2_mechanics/autocrafting)autocrafting$(/l) setup from anywhere within the range of a $(l:items_blocks_machines/wireless_access_point)ME Wireless Access Point$(/l).

pages.title: Upgrades
pages.text: The Wireless Terminal supports the following $(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)upgrades$(/l):$(li)$(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)Energy Card$(/l) in order to increase the battery capacity

The Wireless Crafting Terminal is similar to a regular wireless terminal, with all the same settings and sections, but with an added crafting grid that will be automatically refilled from $(l:ae2_mechanics/import_export_storage)network storage$(/l). Be careful when shift-clicking the output!
